sources.description:
黄舒骏评审席侧影

黄舒骏身着浅蓝衬衫和深色马甲，端坐于白色评委椅上，双手交叠，目光专注地注视舞台。桌面上摆放着水瓶和纸杯，背景中蓝色灯光下的观众若隐若现，营造出综艺节目现场的氛围。

这位台湾音乐人曾于1988年以《马不停蹄的忧伤》出道，后担任EMI唱片华人音乐总监，并为多位华语歌手制作专辑。如今他以犀利而儒雅的评审风格活跃于各类音乐综艺节目，画面中的沉稳神情正是其专业态度的写照。

sources.description:
Huang Shujun’s "两岸" Album Cover

The album cover features a warm, golden-hued close-up of Taiwanese singer-songwriter Huang Shujun. He rests his chin on his hand, looking thoughtfully into the distance. Beside him, the Chinese title "两岸" and his name "黄舒骏" are prominently displayed in stylized characters.

This portrait captures an introspective mood, with soft shadows accentuating his facial features and tousled hair. The minimalist design focuses attention on Huang Shujun’s expression, reflecting the personal and reflective nature of the album.

sources.title: ‎黃舒駿代表作 - 歌單 - Apple Music
sources.description:
黃舒駿《椰林大道》專輯封面

黃舒駿身著深色外套，圍著花紋圍巾，手握一只鳥籠，凝視鏡頭，背景為柔和的淺色調。封面左側以藍色階梯式線條標示專輯名稱「椰林大道」，右側則以粉紅字體印有歌手名字「黃舒駿」。底部文字註明「黃舒駿自己作詞、作曲、自己唱，喜歡聽的可就不只他自己」。

這張封面同時作為 Apple Music 上「黃舒駿代表作」歌單的封面，該歌單收錄 15 首黃舒駿經典作品，總長度 1 小時 14 分鐘，展示了他作為創作歌手的全方位才華。

sources.title: 黄舒骏：现在的流行音乐叫流量音乐更合适_手机新浪网
sources.description:
Portrait of Huang Shujun

Huang Shujun appears in a crisp black suit and tie, standing against a plain gray background. His composed expression and relaxed posture reflect the confidence of a seasoned artist.

The accompanying interview explores his three-decade career, from his 1988 debut album to his groundbreaking role as EMI’s music director producing dozens of records each year. It also covers his surprise at seeing his songs transformed into the jukebox musical “Restless Sorrow,” and his view that modern pop has shifted into “traffic music.”

sources.description:
Huang Shujun’s "山盟海誓" Album Cover

Huang Shujun stands confidently on an open book, dressed in a gray suit, with one hand raised. The oversized pages beneath him suggest a foundation of stories or promises. Behind him, the album title "山盟海誓" is rendered in cracked stone lettering, creating a dramatic, enduring effect.

To the right, the artist’s name "黃舒駿" appears vertically within a red-flamed border, reinforcing his identity. The overall design blends literary imagery with rock-solid typography, reflecting the album’s themes of steadfast vows and emotional depth.

sources.title: ‎馬不停蹄的憂傷 - 黃舒駿的專輯 - Apple Music
sources.description:
黃舒駿《馬不停蹄的憂傷》專輯封面

這張專輯封面以黑白人像為主視覺，黃舒駿的側臉特寫凝視遠方，背景深沉。封面中央以醒目的藍色大字標示「黃舒駿」與「金曲精選專輯 2」，並在下方以白色與紫色字體註明「原錄音、原歌聲、原母帶製作」及「永遠的巨星歌聲，原音重現」。底部還有歌詞摘錄「聽不懂的話，不要因為他親吻了妳 馬不停蹄的憂傷」。

這是黃舒駿於1989年發行的精選專輯《馬不停蹄的憂傷》，共收錄13首歌曲，總長58分鐘。封面設計透過復古的黑白攝影與大膽的色彩字體，營造出懷舊氛圍，突顯歌手的經典地位與音樂魅力。
